points: Your site shows 1,000,000+ happy customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so the click has nothing to trust. Put 1,000,000+ in the first line of three new ads and open two more with a review quote.
Your site offers 25% off when you build your own set, yet 0 of 20 ads mention percent off, so a first visit gives no reason to act. Put 25% off the bundle in the first line of three new ads.

Your site lists free shipping over $99 US, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer weighing the cost has no reason to order. Name the $99 threshold in the first line of ads aimed at new buyers.

Three Shop now ads go to the homepage, so a buyer who clicked for one product lands on a general page. Point each to the product it shows, such as the G-Flex belt or merino socks, so the click matches the ad.
